verdict.rationale: Mailgun is an email-sending API, so idempotent retry semantics are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents idempotency keys, duplicate-suppression semantics, or safe-retry guidance for the send endpoint. The send-related items (domain sending keys, batch sending, SDKs) do not address retries or deduplication.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can retry a failed send safely — idempotency keys or documented duplicate-suppression semantics guarantee a network timeout never double-sends a receipt
